text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaahhh~~~! Every single one of those 
girls was shining ab-so-lute-ly the 
brightest~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To be able to compete seriously with all 
the Umamusume-chans... I'm truly, truly 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, taking first place...! 
I m-m-must accept it with utmost 
humility...!
choice_data_list: You were the one shining the brightest
Let's do our best in the next race, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-N-N-No way...! Someone like me is 
basically invisible anyway...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you really ought to watch the 
other girls' wonderful running more...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that may be true, but~... No 
matter how you look at it, the other 
Umamusume are way more wonderful, and, 
umm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: B-Being praised makes me so fidgety...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's get stronger and stronger so we 
can keep on winning just like this!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And I want to watch the girls shine even 
brighter in even hotter races, right by 
their side...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words, an excitement even 
greater than today is waiting for us in 
the futureee...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyoooh!! Digitan is gonna give it her 
alllll!!
